messages:
noah_csm: Noticing MicroBurstInc onboarding has intermittent microburst p99s ~900ms for very short chat sessions (single-turn <50 tokens). Baseline p95 is fine. They care about consistent sub-300ms UX. Thinking: try session-affinity + small in-route spillover to compact-3b-int4 for hot sessions; also enable short-prompt early-exit and tighten batching window to 10ms. Thoughts?

ops_bot: metric alert: customer=MicroBurstInc window=08:40-09:10 p99=0.91s p95=0.27s request_rate_spike=2.8x

tara_success: MicroBurst said stability matters > absolute perf. They're ok with occasional quality blips if UX felt consistent. Could we do a canary that only affects sessions with avg prompt length <60 tokens?

priya_eng: That filter is doable. Plan: route policy that pins sessions (cookie/session-id) to variant if they hit threshold for 'short' over first 3 requests. Route weights: 80% standard-7b, 20% compact-3b-int4 for pinned short sessions, with spillover to standard-3b if compact-3b reaches queue depth. Collect: per-session latency CDF, quality eval on small random sample, tokenization length diffs.

zane_infra: I'll add an infra guard: auto-spill if queue_latency > 150ms or GPU_util > 78% for that pool. Also will enable KV prefix caching for session-level repeated prompts.

kevin_sre: Make sure we log placement decisions and variant reasons, so we can analyze user impact. Also add a canary window of 3 hours during low churn period.

priya_eng: Deploying canary config now (snippet):
```json
{
  "customer": "microburstinc",
  "route_policy": "session_affinity_filter",
  "session_thresholds": {"short_tokens_max": 60, "seed_requests": 3},
  "variants": [
    {"model": "standard-7b", "weight": 80},
    {"model": "compact-3b-int4", "weight": 20, "spillover": "standard-3b"}
  ],
  "batching": {"max_delay_ms": 10},
  "cache": {"prefix_kv": true}
}
```

noah_csm: Can we add rollback criteria: if sampled manual QA fails by >1.5% or session p99 increases vs baseline by >10%? Also capture 50 golden sessions for manual review.

priya_eng: Yep. Added automatic eval and manual sample capture. Canary started at 06:00 UTC. Initial 45m: short-session median -24%, p95 -30%, p99 -18%. Compact pool queue occasionally reaches spill threshold but spillover keeps errors at 0.

ops_bot: canary update: 45m window short-session p50= -24% p95= -30% p99= -18% cache_hit=37% spillovers=3.2%

tara_success: I'll ping the customer with the canary link and set expectation: 3-hour watch then debrief. Asking them for a simple UX sniff test set to validate subjectively.

kevin_sre: No infra alerts. Will keep an eye on SLO dashboards overnight.

priya_eng: Canary wrapped at 09:00 UTC. Automated eval: relative quality delta -0.6% (within threshold), user-visible latency consistency improved. Cost sim: ~28% token+runtime unit saving for short-heavy traffic. Marking canary PASS.

noah_csm: Great. I'll update onboarding doc with recommended policy, include step-by-step in Console for enabling session-affinity and spillover. I'll loop in renewal team to mention lowered unit cost and improved UX in next touch.

tara_success: I'll schedule a 30-min enablement with MicroBurst product manager tomorrow to walk through the changes and gather their feedback.

priya_eng: We'll follow up with a 1-week health check and a small A/B to verify retention/engagement metrics.

noah_csm: Thanks team. Closing thread, will attach the canary dashboard and the exported eval ZIP to the customer record. :rocket:
